$comment: Check library for the modeling lane: WHAT must be proven, not HOW. `reported_in` says where the result appears and which gate checks it; `pattern` points to the example in this skill's references. A confirmed lesson becomes a check here.

CHK-LEAK-003.title: Causal features: the training ones do not change when future rows enter

CHK-LEAK-001.title: No variable with univariate AUC >= 0.98 in train and valid (binary target)

CHK-DUP-001.title: No feature vector repeated between train and valid

CHK-GAIN-001.title: Kept only with gain >= min gain and a paired-bootstrap CI above 0

CHK-OOT-001.title: The round's code does not cite the holdout or its dates
CHK-OOT-001.reported_in: scan of src/ and notebooks/ (validate_round R11)

CHK-SPLIT-004.title: split.lock with three ordered windows and counts

CHK-OOT-002.title: Drop between valid and OOT within the plan's limit

CHK-MUT-001.title: Mutation: a shuffled target brings the metric to chance level

CHK-MUT-002.title: Mutation: a future column makes CHK-LEAK-001 fail

CHK-SPLIT-002.title: No group (batch, wafer, entity) in two splits

CHK-IMB-001.title: Realistic prevalence in valid and OOT, no resampling outside train

CHK-IMB-002.title: Threshold chosen on valid, never on OOT
